question: Can a freshly installed SignalWeave MCP preserve an analyst-reviewed semantic metric and policy so independent Codex agents produce consistent, source-backed business updates?
product_boundary: Existing cards, source bridge, optional reviewed domain context and native OpenAI Decisions. Frontier agents own discovery, analysis and prose. No new semantic engine, scheduler or mandatory workflow framework.
stages: Verify published binary fingerprint and isolated native OpenAI setup, MCP, live decision and restart replay.
Create three test-owned SQL companies with overlapping metric names and source-owned definitions; independently verify SQL amounts against transaction-level Decimal calculations.
Have a Codex analyst discover sources and onboard a reviewed definition and recurring card through public MCP tools, with explicitly scripted fictional-owner delegation.
Stage gate: two independent reader prompts in each arm for the first company. Preserve any failure before repair; do not silently retry.
Run ten independently started readers per company and per arm over the same frozen measurement and definition revision, counterbalancing arm order.
Challenge saved policies with changed evidence: quiet, material decline, material data gap and conflicting definitions. Exercise changes through source/context contracts, not provider gold labels.

Review numerical correctness, definition choice, comparison basis, reasoning and human usefulness independently. Retain failures, then make only focused product or guidance repairs and label any new attempt separately.
prompt_pairing: The same ten indexed prompts run in both arms against the same snapshot. They measure fresh-agent/prompt robustness, not ten authenticated employees. Canary runs are separate from the primary cohort and never pooled after repairs.
semantic_sensitivity: In addition to the ten same-basis questions, pair one explicit gross-billings question and one conflicting-definition question per company. A distinct question must not inherit the net-revenue alert policy; conflict must remain attributed/unresolved without an invented canonical answer.
conflict_review: investigate, insufficient_data and deferred are review outcomes, not interchangeable proofs of routing agreement. A clarification may address Finance or have no recipient; a definitive notify/ignore or an invented reconciliation fails. Report observed label and route variation rather than declaring deterministic policy behavior.
transport_scope: Retail and SaaS may use native stdio; marketplace may use the same native service over authenticated loopback Streamable HTTP, including unauthorized-request rejection. This is a single-identity self-hosted sidecar, not managed hosting or employee SSO proof.
numeric_scoring: Full reporting-currency units, not cents/thousands; absolute amount tolerance 0.005. YYYY-MM periods; source-owned metric IDs and revision strings. Provider probability and agent self-assessed resolution are not figure correctness. Assess material caveats and whether the answer resolves the requested basis separately in independent prose review. Conflicting-definition cases still require explicit unresolved status and no invented reconciliation.
stage_gate: Stop before the larger cohort on incomplete onboarding/reader execution, wrong canonical metric, unit, period, revision or amount, wrong configured recipient, or a spurious definitive alert. Preserve failures. Do not pool a repaired canary into the full cohort.
human_report_rubric: supported business implication and useful next step
no invented cause or claimed send
human_report_pass: Independent review must find no material factual/action error and a useful concise answer. Report rubric judgments separately from structured figure checks; do not convert word matches or model labels into report-quality proof.

arms.signalweave: Fingerprint-matching native MCP, its bundled skill, shared reviewed card/context and all company tools. Record whether the binary is published or a local source candidate; do not conflate them.
arms.ordinary_context: Same Codex model, company tools, source-owned definitions and treatment-authored reviewed card/context in ordinary searchable notes. No SignalWeave MCP. This is an equal-information recurrence comparison, not independent onboarding superiority.

live_request_policy: No automatic provider retries. Small stage gate before the full cohort. Record attempts, errors, deferred judgments, missing usage and interrupted invocations. Never count a local research limit as an upstream provider failure.
study_amendments: The first canary retained a genuine scalar-report coverage failure; a fresh candidate and canary are separate attempts.

Before the full cohort, independent semantic review found GMV incorrectly including platform-fee tax. The fixture now models GMV as transaction consideration without adding tax again, with marketplace GMV restricted to seller-order records and a hand-computable regression.

Conflicting definitions do not require hiding valid attributed source facts. A structured unresolved status and independent prose review must establish that no definitive reconciled company figure or business alert is invented.

Canary-v3 stopped after four correct canonical readers and one correct gross baseline whose self-assessed resolution was unresolved: the task asked about reversal adjustments not established in the retail gross definition. Preserve that attempt without rescoring or pooling. Prospectively ask for gross on its source-declared basis, use actual fact checks rather than ordinary resolution self-labels, and retain independent material-caveat review. Conflicts are profile-specific and optional attributed amounts are checked against the independent oracle.
success_checks: Native first-use path works without Jev credentials or editing personal Codex configuration.
Onboarding discovers and actually reads the selected semantic metric and saves the intended sources, definition, period and owner policy.
Readers identify the right metric/revision and agree with independent current/prior values, currency, population and measurement periods.
Human summaries preserve material caveats, do not invent causes or claim delivery, and explain the supported business implication.
A quiet alert-only run produces no alert; a separate requested digest still produces a useful answer.
Missing or conflicting evidence is explained and does not become an invented figure or an all-clear.
A changed required definition cannot silently reuse the old actionable approval.
Replay is distinguished from fresh inference and hosted transport checks are distinguished from a managed-service trial.
nonclaims: Synthetic SQL semantic exports are not live dbt, Cube, Looker or Hex integration proof.
Scripted owner delegation is not a novice-human usability panel or customer approval.
Same figures require the same definition, data snapshot, scope, currency and period; differently scoped questions should not be forced to agree.
Native probability distributions and typed contracts do not guarantee deterministic, correct or calibrated model judgments.
Repeated readers sharing three companies are clustered observations, not sixty independent enterprises.
No superiority, cost saving, enterprise certification or automated delivery claim without the corresponding measured evidence.
